# v2.47 Release Notes

This stable release rolls up dev pre-releases **v2.40-dev … v2.47-dev** since the
previous stable (v2.39). Four themes: the app now works properly on a phone, the
heavy report tables load far faster, every paginated list remembers where you
were when you press Back, and the partner-program "View students" pop-up is
clearer.

## Mobile-friendly navigation and layout

The app was built desktop-first; it now works on a small screen with **no change
to desktop behaviour**.

- **Slide-in navigation drawer on phones.** Below the tablet breakpoint the
  sidebar is replaced by a **☰ menu button**; tapping it slides the navigation in
  over a dimmed backdrop, and tapping a link, the ✕, or the backdrop closes it. On
  larger screens the docked sidebar (and its collapse toggle) is unchanged.
- **Roomier content and no clipped controls.** Page padding is reduced on small
  screens and page headers wrap instead of colliding. Wide admin/report tables now
  scroll horizontally so their row-action buttons are always reachable, tall
  dialogs scroll inside themselves instead of running off-screen, the search and
  pagination bars wrap, and the date-range picker fits within a narrow viewport.

## Faster reports — server-side pagination

The six most detail-heavy reports — **By Product Type**, **By Function**,
**Expiring Soon**, **Achievement Over Time**, **Legacy Replacement Gap** and
**Trained But Not Certified** — now compute their charts, KPI cards, filter
options and group subtotals on the server and hand the browser **one page of rows
at a time**, instead of downloading the entire dataset and rendering every row.
This keeps them responsive no matter how large the data grows.

- **Same look, same numbers.** Filtering, searching, column sorting, grouping
  (Theatre / Region / Country) with subtotals, the charts and the chart-click
  filters all behave exactly as before. Exports (CSV / Excel / PDF) still cover the
  **full filtered set**, not just the visible page.
- **One consistent pager everywhere.** The Currently Expired and Learner
  Achievement Scorecard reports (already server-paginated) now use the same
  **Show [N] records / Showing X to Y of N** control with numbered page buttons as
  the rest of the app.

## Every paginated list remembers your view when you go back

Apply a filter (or move to a later page), open a record, and press your browser's
**Back** button — you now land back exactly where you were, instead of with
everything reset.

- Covers **all** the report tables **and** the **Students** and **Training**
  lists (including the per-training "who took this" list): filters, search,
  grouping, sort, **page number** and page size are all kept in the page address.
- Because the view lives in the address, you can also **bookmark or share** a
  specific filtered/paged view.

## Partner program "View students" pop-up is clearer

- **The list now matches the number next to it.** A requirement counted anyone
  holding any variant of the required training or any listed alternative, but the
  drill-down previously listed only exact matches — so the count and the list could
  disagree. They now always agree.
- **One table per training.** The pop-up shows a separate table for each training
  (the primary requirement first, then each alternative / variant) under its own
  heading with a count, titled simply **Students** — so nobody appears to hold a
  training they don't.
- **At-risk holders stand out.** Anyone whose training expires within the next
  **3 months** shows their expiry date in **red**.

## Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- Desktop layout and behaviour, and what the reports show, are unchanged.
